Acxiom helps the world's leading brands use data, technology, analytics, and marketing solutions to better understand and engage their customers. Our Enterprise Solutions Consulting team serves as the bridge between client business challenges and Acxiom's technology, data, and service capabilities.
As an Enterprise Solutions Consulting Intern, you will gain firsthand experience working at the intersection of business strategy, technology, sales, consulting, and client engagement. This internship is designed for students who are interested in pursuing careers in consulting, sales engineering, customer success, solution architecture, business strategy, technology consulting, or enterprise sales.
About the Role
The Enterprise Solutions Consulting Intern will support Acxiom's Solution Engineering team in designing and communicating enterprise solutions that align with both client business objectives and Acxiom's strategic capabilities.
The team is responsible for developing enterprise solution strategies, understanding client business challenges, identifying opportunities where Acxiom can deliver value, and supporting sales efforts that drive pipeline growth and revenue generation.
This internship provides exposure to how complex business solutions are developed, positioned, and presented to prospective clients. You will collaborate with sales, account management, product strategy, delivery teams, and solution architects while learning how organizations evaluate and purchase enterprise-level technology and data solutions.
The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, highly organized, eager to learn, and interested in developing both business and technical consulting skills.
Internship Details:
The internship will begin January 11, 2027.
This internship is based in our New York office, and interns are expected to work onsite.
Interns will work approximately 20–25 hours per week during the school year, with the opportunity to work up to 40 hours per week during academic breaks. Anticipated graduation date of May 2027 or December 2027.
Applicants for this internship position with Acxiom in the U.S. must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with Acxiom (i.e., H-1B visa, F-1 visa [CPT/OPT], TN visa, or any other non-immigrant status).
What You'll Do:
Solution Engineering & Business Analysis
Support the Solution Engineering team in researching and understanding client business challenges and opportunities
Assist in uncovering client business needs and documenting high-level requirements
Help evaluate how Acxiom's capabilities align to client objectives and business outcomes
Learn how enterprise solutions are designed to support long-term client strategy and growth
Sales Support & Revenue Enablement
Support Enterprise Solution Consultants (Sales Engineers) on new business and cross-sell opportunities
Assist with activities that contribute to pipeline development and revenue growth
Help prepare client presentations, proposals, solution summaries, and meeting materials
Participate in internal strategy sessions and client opportunity discussions
Proposal Development & Content Management
Help maintain content libraries and support data governance practices that organize and tag sales collateral, case studies, pitch materials, and proposal content
Assist in creating client-facing presentations and proposal documentation
Support the development of messaging that communicates Acxiom's unique value proposition and competitive differentiation
Market Research & Strategic Insights
Conduct research on industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies
Gather and organize market insights that support strategic recommendations and client conversations
Collaborate with Strategy and Product teams to share observations, feedback, and trends from the marketplace
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with Sales, Product, Strategy, Account Management, Delivery Teams, and Solution Architects
Participate in collaborative projects that help improve Acxiom's products, solutions, and client experience
Observe how complex enterprise solutions are positioned, sold, and implemented

About Our Company
Working at Columbia Threadneedle Investments you'll find growth and career opportunities across all of our businesses.
We're intentionally built to help you succeed. Our reach is expansive with a Columbia Threadneedle Investments global team of 2,300 people working together. Our capability is diverse with more than 550 investment professionals sharing global perspectives across all major asset classes and markets. Our clients have access to a broad array of investment strategies, and we have the capability to create bespoke solutions matched to clients' specific requirements. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our enterprise businesses — Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities.
Job Description
Please note that applications will be assessed on a rolling basis. Due to anticipated interest, the role may close earlier than the stated deadline. We recommend submitting your application promptly. The advertised closing date is October 3, 2026.
At Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments, and RiverSource, we're committed to helping early-career talent grow through meaningful work and practical learning. Whether you're joining us as an Intern or Leadership Development Program participant, you'll work alongside experienced colleagues, contribute fresh perspectives, and gain exposure to the people, projects, and experiences that drive our business forward.
Guided by our values of excellence in all we do and respect for individuals and our communities, participants will have opportunities to connect with Executive Leadership through our ELT Speaker Series, gaining insights from senior leaders across the business, while also making a positive impact through our annual volunteering day.
This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills, expand your network, and explore what's possible across a global financial services organization.
About the Role
As a Sales Intern, you will help promote Columbia Management products through the extensive sales network of Ameriprise Financial Advisors, banks, broker dealers, wire houses and independents.
Key Responsibilities
Support National Sales Team by assisting with inputting literature orders and maintaining management software.
Assist team members with ad hoc projects which require strong communication and project coordination, sometimes across multiple business lines.
Learn and use sales tools and resources, including Morningstar Advisor Workstation, Zephyr on Demand, and fi360.
Required Qualifications
Be a current Junior at a 4-year university pursuing a bachelor’s degree.
Graduation date of December 2027 or May/June 2028.
Available to join June 2027 for the full 10-week internship.
Preferred Qualifications
High degree of self-motivation with strong integrity and ethics.
Proven organization skills and ability to manage time effectively.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
Ability to work and communicate collaboratively and constructively with others.
Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.
Visa Sponsorship
Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).
In-Office Collaboration
We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.
Base Pay Salary
The hourly rate for this role is $31.00 per hour. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurance.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.
Job Description
Intern - PDM - Internal Quality Operational Excellence
As a Gilead intern you will contribute to high-impact meaningful projects that will not only further advance our company’s mission but will allow you to gain real world experience at one of the most innovative organizations in the world. You will also have opportunities to participate in special events including professional development and leadership presentations, social/network building activities and local community volunteer programs.
Key Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:
Dashboard & Data Analytics Support
Assist in developing and maintaining Operational Excellence dashboards and reports using Microsoft Office and data visualization tools.
Collect, clean, and analyze operational data from QA and QC processes.
Support tracking of key performance indicators (KPIs), project milestones, and benefit realization metrics.
Help identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for process improvement.
Prepare data summaries, presentations, and visualizations for leadership reviews.
Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence
Support Operational Excellence projects focused on process simplification, standardization, and efficiency improvements.
Participate in Lean, Six Sigma, and root cause analysis activities.
Assist with mapping current-state processes and documenting improvement opportunities.
Contribute to the development of standard work, process documentation, and improvement recommendations.
Project Coordination
Assist with project planning, meeting coordination, action item tracking, and project documentation.
Support cross-functional teams in executing Operational Excellence initiatives.
Monitor project progress and help maintain project dashboards and status reports.
Participate in team meetings and provide updates on assigned deliverables.
Quality Systems & Compliance Exposure
Gain exposure to Quality Assurance and Quality Control processes in a regulated environment.
Support documentation reviews and data gathering activities related to quality initiatives.
Learn foundational principles of GMP, GLP, and quality systems.
Assist in maintaining accurate project records and documentation.
Learning Opportunities
Lean and Six Sigma methodologies
Process improvement and operational excellence practices
Quality systems within the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry
Dashboard development and performance metrics
Data analytics and business insights
Cross-functional project management
Executive-level reporting and communication
Showcase your work with a final presentation (PPT) near the conclusion of your internship

Must be at least 18 years of age at the start of the internship.
Must be enrolled full‑time in a Bachelor’s, Master’s, MBA, JD or PhD program at a nationally accredited U.S. college or university, with continued full‑time enrollment required in the Fall semester following the internship.
Must be currently enrolled as an undergraduate (freshman, sophomore, junior, or senior) or as a graduate/doctoral student.
Must have a minimum overall cumulative GPA of 2.8 at the time of application and hire (official transcripts will be requested).
Must be independently authorized to work in the United States now and in the future (current or future work authorization must not require school or employer sponsorship).
Must be able to commit to a full‑time internship lasting 10–12 consecutive weeks between May and August.
Must be willing and able to work at the designated site for the duration of the internship (relocation may be required). All internships are hybrid; fully remote roles are not offered.

At Air Manufacturing Innovation (Air MI), we deliver on Nike’s most daring dream: giving every athlete the unparalleled sensation of walking on air. Qualifications
